hero.title: Let's start here.
hero.description: Whether you would like to request a session or ask about physiotherapy, get in touch to learn about the next step.

methods.title: Choose how to get in touch

booking.title: Request a Session
booking.description: Enter your basic details and we will prepare a message for WhatsApp.
booking.name: Full Name
booking.privacyNote: Your information is not stored on this website. You can review and send the message through WhatsApp.

booking.question: How can I book my first session?
booking.answer: Contact us on WhatsApp to ask about available appointments and the booking process.

preparation.question: What should I bring to my first session?
preparation.answer: You may bring any previous reports or scans related to your condition, if available.

consultation.question: Can I ask a question before booking?
consultation.answer: Yes. You can send an initial inquiry through WhatsApp before requesting a session.

service.question: How do I know which service is right for me?
service.answer: You can describe your inquiry when contacting the doctor, who can advise on the appropriate next step after assessment.
